Advertising & Media Sales – Housing TV Africa - Drive advertising sales, programme sponsorships and branded content partnerships for Housing TV Africa. - Secure advertising contracts from real estate companies, banks, mortgage institutions, building materials manufacturers and other relevant industries. - Develop commercial opportunities across television, digital platforms, YouTube, social media and special productions. - Package and sell sponsored programmes, interviews, documentaries, special reports and corporate media campaigns. - Build sustainable relationships with advertising agencies and corporate marketing departments. 4. Strategic Partnerships & Corporate Relations - Establish and maintain strategic relationships with government agencies, corporate organisations, professional associations and development institutions. - Develop local and international partnerships that enhance business growth. - Represent AIHS and Housing TV Africa at corporate meetings, conferences, exhibitions and networking events. - Identify opportunities for new markets, international collaborations and business expansion. - Maintain professional relationships with clients while protecting the reputation and commercial interests of both organisations. 5. Business Development Team Leadership - Supervise, mentor and coordinate business development and sales personnel. - Set clear sales targets and monitor individual and team performance. - Conduct regular sales reviews and pipeline meetings. - Ensure proper documentation of leads, client engagements, proposals and commercial transactions. - Promote a culture of discipline, accountability, ethical conduct and measurable performance. 6.
